To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
“IT managers should be aware that systems’ and individuals’ characteristics can influence the resistance to enterprise systems.”
“the characteristics of the ERP system and the individual's inclination to resist change influence resistance to the implementation of ERP systems.”
“the resistance to enterprise systems is influenced by both the characteristics of the system itself and by the users’ personal inclination to resist change.”
In summary, our research is concerned with
the antecedents of resistance behavior to enterprise system implementations, and it is the first to investigate the IT leadership perspective.
the IT leadership perspective of ERP resistance and contributes to the literature in the following ways.
the identification of the main factors that influence resistance to ERP systems.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
resistance to ERP systems is influenced by a combination of the characteristics of the ERP system and the predisposition of the IT leader toward resistance to change.
the characteristics of a new enterprise system, and the predisposition of individuals toward change, can lead to resistance behavior to ERP systems.
the resistance antecedent factors are related to the characteristics of the system and the personal characteristics of users.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
IT managers should be aware of the resistance antecedent factors that may influence ERP system implementation, especially the “systems” factor, as it is the most influential factor in our model.
IT managers need to take into consideration the resistance antecedent factors in order to minimize the resistance to enterprise systems.
the IT leadership perspective is a valuable one to consider in order to better comprehend resistance to ERP implementation.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the characteristics of an enterprise system and the individual’s personal inclination toward resistance to change can lead IT managers to resist the implementation of an ERP system, which can be a serious obstacle to the implementation of such systems in organizations.
IT managers should be aware of the factors that influence the resistance to enterprise systems in order to mitigate the effects of this phenomenon on the implementation of enterprise systems.

the IT management team should take into account the characteristics of the ERP systems to be implemented and the personal inclination of its employees to resist change when planning an ERP implementation.
